endpoint_carrier: black major-axis model line reconstructed by the source authors from their rotation curve
primary_radial_policy: retain only abs(offset) at or beyond the source COMING bar radius; keep approaching and receding sides separate before averaging
central_exclusion_reason: bar and nuclear spiral produce strong non-circular motions and kinematic twist
digitization_policy: render at 300 dpi; identify near-black connected curve pixels inside the calibrated plot interior; exclude axes, labels and isolated components; sample fixed 5-arcsec bins
quality_gates: both sides cover at least three post-bar bins
side disagreement is retained as endpoint uncertainty
reverse-rendered curve overlays the source black line
no formula or morphology parameter changes after extraction
claim_boundary: prospective graphical endpoint protocol; not yet extracted or scored
